source: Acceptance-list-first engine: scan every tournament from source_tennis_europe_tournaments, parse every event, include tracked players in MD/Q/A with live labels; Withdrawn excluded.

drawRules.rule: Q/A: check qualifying draw from day -1; remove if absent from tournament start. MD: check main draw on day 0, 1 and 2; remove if absent after day 2. If found, remove MD/Q/A label and keep player.
